subject: prd/feature-draft
statement: The system shall treat a feature draft as ready only when its PRD holds every section the PRD template in force requires, §0 read-to-rule, the definition of done, and contract readiness included.
rationale: Draft-born PRDs follow the PRD template (brainstorm:feature-draft#D-20, brainstorm:feature-draft#D-21)
fit_criterion: A draft PRD missing §0, the definition of done, or contract readiness is refused naming the section; a complete PRD passes.
